A1.justification: Both complete 17-page PDFs describe the same DDE research. Text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material on pages 15–17 support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original DDE experiments on noisy test-time adaptation and OOD detection, with additional benchmark results and sensitivity analyses in the supplement.

after.justification: Retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and the supplement, including benchmark comparisons, component ablations, robustness analyses, and efficiency measurements.

M1.justification: DDE's PFDE, NLDE, adaptive thresholding, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Correcting two Figure 2 labels from 'Test Encoder' to 'Text Encoder' does not change the method already specified in the text.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage is identical, including ImageNet variants, fine-grained recognition, diverse OOD scenarios, and supplementary near-OOD, OpenOOD, and CIFAR evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within every comparison. Tables 2–3 retain ZS-CLIP, Tent, TPT, DMN, AdaNeg, OODD, and AdaND; the supplementary CIFAR comparisons still include SoTTA.

E3.justification: The experimental protocols, model configurations, metrics, and settings are identical. Section 4.1 and Table S1 retain the same zero-shot evaluation setup, thresholds, cache size, batch size, and other hyperparameters.

E4.justification: Table 5's component ablations, Figure 3's robustness and sensitivity analyses, Table 6's OOD scenarios, and Figure S1's prompt, exclusion, and threshold analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. Statistical and uncertainty reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are identical, including supplementary results. For example, DDE's ImageNet average harmonic accuracy remains 76.79% in Table 2, and average FPR95 remains 9.80% in Table 4.

T1.justification: The Gaussian assumptions, mathematical definitions, and derivations are unchanged, including Equations 1–12 and supplementary Equation S1.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about training-free dual distribution estimation, robustness, efficiency, and the reported advantages over AdaND.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of the experimental findings are identical. The conclusion retains the same limitation concerning memory overhead from class-wise Gaussian parameters.

D1.justification: Implementation details, supplementary hyperparameters, hardware and timing information, and project/code access links are unchanged. No additional reproducibility information is disclosed.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works, and the reference list are identical. Positioning relative to AdaND, AdaNeg, OODD, and other prior methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: Two occurrences of 'Test Encoder' become 'Text Encoder' in Figure 2, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Narrative wording and document organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 corrects the text in two encoder boxes while retaining its graphical structure and caption. The first-page version stamp changes; all other pages render identically.

improvement.justification: The two Figure 2 typo corrections provide a very small clarity benefit, but the text already identified the intended text encoder. Scientific content, empirical support, reproducibility information, and limitations are unchanged, so the revision makes no meaningful difference to overall paper quality.
